cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The 'title' field is directly assigned from untrusted JSON input without any sanitization, which could lead to XSS if this value is later rendered in a web page.
Direct assignment of untrusted JSON input ('message' field) to the 'title' field without sanitization creates XSS vulnerability when this value is rendered in a web page.
Passing untrusted JSON input directly to ValidatorNuContext constructor without sanitization may propagate XSS vulnerability if the context data is later rendered in a web page.
